description: Words I'm learning: a note per word, named by the word, with its meaning, its reading, examples in the body, and when to review it next

meaning.description: What the word means: a translation or a short definition

reading.description: How it is read: pinyin with tone marks (nǐ hǎo), kana, or a pronunciation

stage.description: How well I say I know it; only I set it

createdAt.description: When it was added, RFC 3339 with an offset

due.description: When it is next due for review; a word without one is new and due now

interval.description: Days between the last review and the next (SM-2)

ease.description: How fast the interval grows after a good review (SM-2), 2.5 to start

reps.description: Reviews in a row remembered since it was new or last forgotten
